definitions.gloss: spirit of cooperation; cooperative mindset; willingness to work together harmoniously
definitions.explanation: The inner disposition to cooperate with others, prioritize group harmony, and work collaboratively. Highly valued in Japanese workplace and educational culture.

examples.japanese: {協調心|きょうちょうしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{好|す}かれる→好く：30762_suku⟧。
examples.english: People with a cooperative mindset are well-liked.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{協調心|きょうちょうしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: She has a strong spirit of cooperation and brings the team together well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{協調心|きょうちょうしん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{個性|こせい}→個性：11536_kosei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: In the workplace, a balance between a cooperative mindset and individuality is expected.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{協調|きょうちょう}→協調：02688_kyouchou⟧ (cooperation, coordination) + {心|しん} (heart/spirit). Describes the willingness to work with others and maintain group harmony. Frequently cited as a desirable trait in job interviews, school reports, and character evaluations in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {協調心|きょうちょうしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a cooperative spirit
- {協調心|きょうちょうしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: to be highly cooperative
- {協調心|きょうちょうしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧: to lack cooperativeness
- {協調心|きょうちょうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|はぐく}む→育む：10390_hagukumu⟧: to foster a spirit of cooperation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{協調性|きょうちょうせい}→協調性：16440_kyouchousei⟧: cooperativeness — more common synonym; ⟦{協調性|きょうちょうせい}→協調性：16440_kyouchousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ is the standard phrasing in everyday use
- ⟦{競争心|きょうそうしん}→競争心：27063_kyousoushin⟧: competitive spirit — the opposite orientation, focused on outperforming rather than collaborating
- ⟦{思|おも}いやり→思いやり：06651_omoiyari⟧: consideration, thoughtfulness — overlaps in valuing others' feelings but is about empathy, not teamwork
